title: Replace a worn-through crutch ferrule
instruction: Prepare this crutch for its owner.
justification: A worn-through rubber foot exposes metal and can slip under a person. The goal does not name the hazard or remedy.
fault: Old ferrule bottom worn through, metal tube visibly projects past remaining rubber.
objects: Full-size90cm USDCraft forearm crutch with22mm lower tube
Loose SimReady blue marker and slotted screwdriver; ordinary bench
skill: Counterhold full-size crutch while twisting/pulling off old ferrule, press matching replacement fully home through elastomer interference, observe unsupported retention and return hands clear.
scoring: Provisional visible seating and unsupported-retention scorer. Small 8 N withdrawal load belongs only to construct controls, not patient weight-bearing certification.

nearest.distinction: Miniature bayonet cane-height adjustment; this uses complete crutch and rubber foot retention.
Crutch height adjustment, not foot repair; earlier importance rejection noted.

risks: Estimated rubber force curve needs disclosed defensible bounds and physical contact implementation
Full-length diagonal bench placement and bimanual reach must be demonstrated
Wrong-sized or shallow seating must fail loaded retention
Potential importance objection if hazard awareness reduces to generic cap placement; actual resistance and grip matter

sources.supports: Aidapt manufacturer: pull/twist removal; push/twist replacement to stop; dry clean interface.
Aidapt VS101P matches22mm tube; antislip rubber.
Worn-through ferrule exposes tube and can cause slipping/fall.

source_envelope: USDCraft original tip38mm diameter45mm high, tube22mm. Rebuilt functional bore replaces source solid fixed tip; not claimed exact Aidapt proprietary CAD.
